'''Tower Defense Simulator Clothing''' ---- Tower Defense Simulator has various '''Clothing''' made by clothing designers, which are currently only displayed in the game's official Discord server but was at one point shown off in the lobby's clothing area. This page only includes '''Clothing''' presented in the featured clothing channel of the Tower Defense Simulator Discord server. It does not include any [[Tower Defense Simulator UGC]] that may have been made alongside the set of clothing.
